text_block_list.text:
After our outing—heading along the coast, 
I saw Cheval Grand with a solemn look, 
talking somberly to an elderly man.

text_block_list.name: Tackle Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
With all the different kinds of 
entertainment out there nowadays, you 
know? A lot of customers just drifted away 
from fishing.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...S-So... that's... how it is, then...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Cheval! What's the matter? Why the 
long face?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
U-Um... the tackle shop I used to go to 
all the time... they said... they're 
closing down...

text_block_list.name: Tackle Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Cheval-chan visited so often too... I 
really wish I could've held out just a 
little longer.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I-In that case... um... well... ...No... 
never mind, it's nothing..."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...The tackle shop owner doesn't want to 
close down. And Chevalier doesn't want the 
shop to close down either—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then it's simple! Let's just make it so we 
don't have to fold it at all!!

And so, egged on by Epiphaneia, Cheval 
Grand's "Keep the Shop Open Operation" 
began, but—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
……It's a flyer…… for a tackle shop. Ugh…… 
No one will take one from me……

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Mmm! If I don't do something way flashier, 
maybe they won't even be interested!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Fl-Flashy?! S-Something flashy... Umm, 
err—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-Is the stream... live right now...? 
U-Um............ w-well...

text_block_list.name: Social Media Comment
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing Cheval stream is so rare~!" 
"Cheval! We're rooting for you in your 
races!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I'm happy you're cheering, but... 
This time... w-well... it's not like 
that...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: …………I couldn't convey it well at all...

Neither the flyer strategy nor the brave 
streaming strategy yielded the results we 
had hoped for.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... I'm going to... hand out flyers... 
one more time.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I can do... I want to do it, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I felt your determination loud and clear, 
Cheval! I'll take care of the rest from 
here!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
How I'll do it... is just riding the 
momentum of the moment!!

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Wh-What! That tuna...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It's just a model! But still, wouldn't 
everyone love to catch a fish this huge?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If it sounds even a little interesting to 
you, come check out the tackle shop! 
Beginners are more than welcome!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
The dangling string is hopping up and 
down~♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Now's the time~ reel in the rod~♪ 
Ooh~~... Strike!☆"

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Huh, is there some kind of event going on 
today...? Maybe I'll check it out for a 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Oh—hey you, the one who just stopped! Out 
of the blue, but are you interested in 
fishing?!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Nobody gathered at all!? I could 
have sworn I invited a ton of people!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... There's no one in front of the 
store yet...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that's weird! ...Alright, I'll go 
check one more time!

text_block_list.name: Tackle Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, that's more than enough. You've 
done so much, I couldn't be happier.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm going! No matter what you say, 
I'm going!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I've decided to help! I made up my mind!! 
So even if things don't go a little 
smoothly, it's no big deal at all!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because I'm Epiphaneia! I can definitely 
pull it off! Right?!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Epi-san...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...! Oh, those people are...

text_block_list.name: Energetic Youths
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, there you are! The fun helper!" "Umm, 
we'd like to try fishing~!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh! The people who watched the concert! 
And the people who looked at the tuna 
model, too!

text_block_list.name: Energetic Youths
text_block_list.text:
"'Fishing seems fun, almost like a video 
game.' 'Aren't these tools, like, super 
cute?!'"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Epi-san. I couldn't have pulled 
this off... on my own.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You were the first one who wanted to help 
the shop! You reached out your hand... 
It's all thanks to you!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia

Alright, let's all do it together! We're

text_block_list.name: Tackle Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
To think this many people would visit my 
place, huh... —Alright, I gotta keep 
working hard!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I'll keep visiting too. From now 
on... always...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm coming too! And Trainer's coming 
with me!
